featured.title: Featured Quy Nhon – Phu Yen tours
featured.description: From day tours to five-day journeys combining both provinces. Choose by the time you have.

regions.title: Choose by region
regions.description: Four regions, each with its own climate, scenery and travelling rhythm.

values.title: How we choose an experience
values.description: Four principles applied to every journey, including a one-day tour.
values.imageAlt: Central Vietnam coastline seen from above

principles.title: Fewer places, deeper stays
principles.body: Each journey focuses on one cluster of places instead of rushing through many. Travel time is planned up front so you get real time at each stop.

principles.title: Itineraries that say what is included
principles.body: Every tour lists what is and is not included. A price that is not confirmed shows “Contact us for pricing”, never a zero.

principles.title: Direct advice, no pressure
principles.body: This website only takes requests. You talk to an advisor, see the price and the conditions, then decide.

principles.title: Honest when we are unsure
principles.body: Anything that needs confirming — prices, cancellation terms, boat schedules — is checked again before we send it to you.

guides.title: Prepare before you set off
guides.description: Practical notes on timing, transport and the places worth your time.

consult.title: Which trip are you thinking about?
consult.description: Leave a few details and SEA TRIP will suggest destinations, timing and options — completely free.

contact.metaDescription: Send a request for Quy Nhon – Phu Yen tours and other Vietnam routes. SEA TRIP TRAVEL replies during working hours.
contact.heroTitle: Tell SEA TRIP where you want to go
contact.heroDescription: Fill in the form or call us. The clearer your dates and party size, the faster and more accurate the advice.
contact.addressNote: Please make an appointment before visiting the office
contact.outOfHours: Outside working hours, requests are still recorded and handled on the next working day.
contact.formDescription: All we need is your name, phone number and confirmation. The other fields make the advice more accurate.

steps.title: 1. SEA TRIP receives your request
steps.body: The request goes to the advisory team together with the tour you were viewing and the page you sent it from.

steps.title: 2. An advisor gets back to you
steps.body: During working hours, an advisor calls or replies by email to clarify what you need.

steps.title: 3. You receive options and a quote
steps.body: You get a detailed itinerary, pricing by party size and the applicable conditions to decide on.
